description: A finite ground equality problem has a nonempty model if and only if no input disequation belongs to the bounded congruence closure on its finite subterm support.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.hasModel_iff.{u, v} {L : FirstOrder.Language}
  [(n : ℕ) → DecidableEq (L.Functions n)] (P : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.Problem L) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.HasModel P ↔
    ∀ p ∈ P.disequations,
      p ∉
        Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.closure (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.GroundEquality.support P)
          P.equations
